title: Consistent Ruined Equipment
description: Makes Ruined Equipment items consistent with modded items
body:
This resourcepack makes [Ruined Equipment](https://modrinth.com/mod/ruined-equipment)'s items look the same, because this mod doesn't have variety for modded items and I thought that it's weird. also better texture, make your own lore why it looks like that.

![consistency.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aef96bed948be2ea06c590834d09f0882a1bc1f3.png)

If you want to change texture, go to `assets\ruined_equipment\textures\item\` and change `broken_item.png`. every item is assigned to this texture.
